purpose: Freeze the EOReader 6.1 provider surfaces The Fold relies on so EOReader 7 can preserve behavior through a compatibility facade while reorganizing internals.
canonicalV7Capabilities: source material remains addressable and reopenable
reading can proceed incrementally without whole-document recomputation
segmentation is discovered from form rather than imposed by the application
referents and coreference can be revised as later witness changes the Fold
relations are discovered and can be re-canonicalized after identity revision
witness remains distinct from prior nomination and provisional interpretation
epistemic state is reconstructed from append-only witnessed experience and EO transformations
EO operator algebra remains available as a consumable engine capability
surprise is derived from consequential DeltaFold rather than observation novelty
tension is derived from persistent unresolved Fold obligations and release from their transformation
typed absence and null-arm behavior remain explicit rather than silently guessed
terrain, kind, referent, relation, graph and atmosphere views remain derivable as projections
priors remain defeasible, provenance-bearing inputs to orientation/perception rather than evidence
The Fold can run unchanged against an EOReader 7 compatibility facade before native v7 migration
migrationLaw: Current module paths are compatibility commitments, not declarations of EOReader 7 internal architecture.
EOReader 7 may satisfy this contract through a v6 compatibility facade over the canonical recursive Fold kernel.
No compatibility surface may be removed until The Fold has migrated to a canonical v7 replacement and equivalent behavior is covered by tests.
The Fold is the reference application acceptance test for the EOReader 7 transition.
